verdict.rationale: GlitchTip is an error-tracking SaaS product that exposes a built-in MCP server so external AI tools can pull its data (glitchtip-docs-9, glitchtip-probe-4) — it acts as the MCP server/provider, not as an MCP client consuming other servers' tools. Plugging external MCP servers into GlitchTip so it can use their tools is not a fit for this product's category.
